hook: Your hotel room here can be underground.
title: Your Hotel Room Is Dug Into a Hillside
description:
In Coober Pedy, Australia, locals dug homes into the hillside to escape the desert heat. Hotels, bedrooms and even churches sit inside the rock. Part of the Places That Shouldn't Exist series.

#Shorts #Geography #PlacesThatShouldntExist
